# The mirrors that install-browsers.sh starts with, before the runner image's.
# Those start with azure.archive.ubuntu.com, which resolves to a mirror in the runner's Azure region,
# and the westus and westus3 mirrors relay packages from upstream at ~50 kB/s:
# https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/14823
https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/	priority:1
https://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/	priority:2
